I have farmed this land since I was young, and I learned everything from my father and from watching my neighbors. For this small maize plot, I will carry two basketfuls of manure from the pile near my house, and I will buy one bag of DAP from the cooperative to share across my fields, putting a small amount in the planting holes. I keep my own maize seed from last year's harvest — I do not waste money on new seeds when mine still grow. I will plough with my oxen, and my family can manage the weeding and harvesting on this small piece without hiring anyone.
